metadata.title: Supplementary Data for an Archival ALMA Search for Technosignatures toward Stars within 40 pc
metadata.description: Machine-readable data and code for an archival search for narrow-band radio technosignatures toward stars within 40 pc in public ALMA observations: the per-window catalogue of 1663 spectral windows, the Class A and Class B sensitivity measurements, the 53 threshold crossings with their line attributions and recurrence tests, the control-field statistics, the inputs and seeds of the block resampling behind the chance comparison, the 10332 injection trials behind the completeness factor, the execution-block and session membership, the programs that rebuild the article's statistical and calibration summaries from these files, and the search pipeline as it ran. The second file holds the dynamic spectra at the star and at control positions around each crossing.
metadata.notes: Rebuild: unzip ALMA_Technosignatures_40pc.zip; cd ALMA_Technosignatures_40pc/code; python3 reproduce.py
